## Getting Started

Replace this content with your documentation.

### Adding Documents

Create `.qmd` files in this directory. Each file with a YAML front matter block
becomes a build target. Target names are derived from the relative path with
path separators replaced by hyphens:

- `docs/index.qmd` becomes `index`
- `docs/guide/index.qmd` becomes `guide-index`

### Building

```bash
# Build all targets
sdb build .

# Build a single target
sdb build . index

# Build with website profile (parallel)
sdb build . --website -j 4
```
